PHPhotoLibrary.shared().performChanges({ let request = PHAssetCollectionChangeRequest(for: self.assetCollection)! request.removeAssets([self.asset as Any] as NSArray) }, completionHandler: completion) } else { // Delete the asset from the photo library.
